title: CtlHealthResponse
description: Liveness of the control-plane daemon itself — NOT of any tenant (that is `GET /v1/fleet`). Anonymous on purpose: the gateway and `doctor` probe it before any credential exists, and nothing in it is sensitive.

version.description: The build version (`git describe --tags --always --dirty` at build time), the same value `GET /v1/version` reports as `version`.
